title: HG ni Koisuru Futari
synonyms: Two Girls in Love with High Grade Model Kits
Two People in Love with HG
synopsis: When she was 14, Sayaka Kanzaki had her first encounter with Gundam, and her fascination for MS was awakened as if by fate. But her family and friends did not understand the hobby, so she had to hide her interest from the world. Until one day, when she met a high school girl, Sora Takamiya, who loved Gundam models, too...! When two people who love Gundam meet, it's the beginning of something new–––. A story about how it feels “to like” something; a “Gunpla” slice-of-life comedy featuring an almost-thirty OL and a JK!! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Notes - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category. - Includes 15 extra chapters.

title: Nekonome Yuuka wa Katarubekarazu
titleNative: 猫ノ目ゆうかは語るべからず
synopsis: “This academy has multiple ‘taboos’—” Seirin Girls' Academy — a prestigious institution steeped in history, renowned as one of the prefecture's foremost finishing schools for young ladies. Mio Tsujihara, who has just transferred here, finds herself strongly drawn to a figure deemed taboo: Yuka Nekomine. Meeting Yuka will draw Mio into more inexplicable events. Because… "Yuka Nekomine is dead." Who was she, really? And what is the secret hidden within this academy where so many brilliant, delicate girls live? The most terrifying school mystery, filled with unsettling unease and psychological terror! (Source; Young Champion Web, translated)

titleRomaji: Aisare Tenshi na Classmate ga, Ore ni Dake Itazura ni Hohoemu

synonyms: The Classmate Who Is Adored by Everyone Smiles Teasingly Only at Me
synopsis: Ichise Soma is a high school boy who dreams of becoming a pastry chef. One day, he shared some of the desserts he made with his classmate Chika Satomi. Chika is a pure, beautiful girl who is known as "the angel of grace" around the school. He thought she would just say something nice and polite about his desserts, but she showed a surprising side of her personality when they were alone together, and it's getting him all flustered! It's a sweet and exciting boy-meets-girl story with a naughty angel who loves desserts! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Invincible Summoner Who Crawled Up from Level 1
titleEnglish: The Invincible Summoner Who Crawled Up from Level 1
titleNative: レベル１から始まる召喚無双
synopsis: After losing his father in a tragic accident, Shinobu Iijima and his younger sister Megumi are taken in by their father's old friend, Ayumu. Shinobu works hard in the hopes of starting a new life for himself. Megumi, and a mobile game called La Vita Online, are the only things keeping him afloat. One day, Ayumu reveals his true intentions of tearing Shinobu down and getting his hands on Megumi. But just after Shinobu learns that Ayumu deleted all of his game data in La Vita, their high-rise apartment catches on fire and Shinobu falls to his death, Megumi in tow. He wakes up in a strange new world... and realizes he's been reincarnated into the world of La Vita Online. An announcement from the devs tells him that Ayumu is already there, and a countdown to Megumi's arrival is ticking. Shinobu vows to protect Megumi after she arrives at any cost, even if it means he has to crawl his way up from level 1 to fend off all the other reincarnated players. (Source: J-Novel Club)

titleNative: マギクラフト・マイスター
synopsis: There is only one Magi Craft Meister in the world. After the death of the last Meister over one thousand years ago, Jin Nidou was transported to another world in order to succeed her will. After obtaining the knowledge of the Magi Craft Meister, Jin attempts to use a warp gate but it malfunctions, transporting him to an unknown world. Along with that, an automata he recently restored also uses the warp gate in order to search for her “father”. Thus, the crafting journey of the new Magi Craft Meister begins!

Having no desire to become the Demon Lord, he sits around in the Demon Lord's castle as a random low rank guardian. Healing up the Hero party and then preparing to send them back to town, he notices the female priest and falls in love at first sight! (Source: Manga Mirai)

Kao Fa Xiaowo Bianshen Dingji Xiangdao
synopsis: The twin brothers love me too much. What should I do? D-class guide Qiao Yang, because of a drunken accident, discovered that he could use the two A-class sentinels, his childhood friends Zheng Jia and Zheng Yan, to enhance his own class. In order to retain this rare S-class status, he chose to conceal his exploitation of them. However, during the repeated interaction with the two, he gradually becomes aware of their feelings towards him… (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Originally serialized under the title “Kao Fa Xiaowo Bianshen Dingji Xiangdao (靠发小我变身顶级向导)”.

title: Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time
titleEnglish: Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time
titleNative: いずれ最強の錬金術師？
synonyms: Someday Will I Be The Greatest Alchemist?
synopsis: Not even a hero, Takumi Iruma gets accidentally mixed in with a group of heroes chosen to be summoned to another world. As compensation for the mix-up, a goddess offers him the right to choose any skill he wishes for! Hoping for a peaceful and quiet life that has nothing to do with fighting or going into battle, he chooses a seemingly boring creation skill. However, it turns out "alchemy" is the most powerful skill that allows him to create everything from a holy sword to flying ships! This cheat skill he unexpectedly acquired turns him into a wealthy merchant and makes him undefeatable in battles! A heartwarming adventure story about (possibly) the most powerful alchemist in another world! (Source: Alpha Manga)
